nodes.label: victoria-metrics-prod main
nodes.desc: Single-node entrypoint: wires vmstorage.Init (L99), vmselect.Init (L101), vminsert.Init (L103); defaults to :8428 (L93).

nodes.label: vmagent main
nodes.desc: Standalone agent binary entrypoint (main at L105): scrapes or receives metrics and pushes them via remotewrite.

nodes.label: remotewrite client
nodes.desc: Remote-write client (client struct at L92) that shards, retries and streams blocks to a VictoriaMetrics /api/v1/write endpoint.

nodes.label: vmstorage main
nodes.desc: Storage app: -storageDataPath flag (L29), Init (L123) calls storage.MustOpenStorage (L167), publishes VMInsertAPI (L200).

nodes.label: VMStorage facade
nodes.desc: Facade API: newVMStorage (L40), WriteRows (L130) -> Storage.AddRows (L139), InitSearch (L167) returns block iterators for vmselect.

nodes.label: vminsert main
nodes.desc: Ingestion router: Init (L91) starts protocol servers, RequestHandler (L134) maps HTTP paths; /prometheus/api/v1/write at L171.

nodes.label: promremotewrite
nodes.desc: Prometheus remote-write protocol handler: InsertHandler (L23) decompresses snappy protobuf, insertRows (L34) converts TimeSeries.

nodes.label: InsertCtx
nodes.desc: Shared insert context: InsertCtx (L52), WriteDataPoint (L133), FlushBufs (L275) calls VMInsertAPI.WriteRows (L292).

nodes.label: relabel
nodes.desc: Ingestion-side relabeling rules: ApplyRelabeling (L117) rewrites or drops labels before rows are stored.

nodes.label: vmselect main
nodes.desc: Query router: Init (L49) inits tmp blocks dir and rollup cache, /api/v1/query (L207), /api/v1/query_range (L216), /vmui UI (L454).

nodes.label: prometheus API
nodes.desc: Prometheus-compatible /api/v1 handlers: seriesCount, export and label endpoints calling netstorage.ProcessSearchQuery (L135).

nodes.label: promql Exec
nodes.desc: Entry point Exec (L37): parses the query with cache, evaluates it and converts timeseries into netstorage.Result objects.

nodes.label: promql evalExpr
nodes.desc: Expression evaluator: EvalConfig (L116) carries limits and deadline, evalExpr (L257) walks the AST, fetches data at L1834.

nodes.label: rollup functions
nodes.desc: Rollup function zoo over windows: rollupAvg (L1541), rollupMin (L1561), rollupMax (L1580) and dozens more.

nodes.label: rollup result cache
nodes.desc: Persistent cache of rollup results: InitRollupResultCache (L119), rollupResultCache type (L202), invalidated on storage restarts.

nodes.label: netstorage
nodes.desc: Fetch layer: ProcessSearchQuery (L1090) fans a SearchQuery out, merges blocks into Results (L45).

nodes.label: Storage
nodes.desc: Root TSDB type: MustOpenStorage (L183) validates retention, AddRows (L1659) buffers raw rows, SearchTSIDs (L1270) drives lookups.

nodes.label: Search / SearchQuery
nodes.desc: Search abstractions: Search (L166) streams compressed blocks, SearchQuery (L323), NewSearchQuery (L355).

nodes.label: table
nodes.desc: Table of monthly partitions: mustOpenTable (L91), MustAddRows (L300) routes rawRow batches, ForceMergePartitions (L278).

nodes.label: tableSearch
nodes.desc: Merged view over matching partitions: Init (L62), NextBlock (L120) streams blocks in timestamp order.

nodes.label: partition
nodes.desc: One month of data + its indexDB: newPartition (L296), mustOpenParts (L1767), background mergeParts (L1234) with retentionDeadline (L1427).

nodes.label: partitionSearch
nodes.desc: Iterator over a partition's parts for a set of TSIDs (partitionSearch at L13).

nodes.label: mergeBlockStreams
nodes.desc: K-way merge core: mergeBlockStreams (L19), mergeBlocks (L160), skipSamplesOutsideRetention (L205) enforces retention during merges.

nodes.label: DeduplicateSamples
nodes.desc: Deduplication: DeduplicateSamples (L30) keeps one sample per -dedup.minScrapeInterval window.

nodes.label: inmemoryPart
nodes.desc: Recently ingested data held in RAM (inmemoryPart at L15) before being flushed to an on-disk part.

nodes.label: part
nodes.desc: Immutable sorted part on disk or in memory (part at L30) - the unit merges operate on.

nodes.label: partHeader
nodes.desc: Part metadata: item counts, time range and block index offsets (partHeader at L19).

nodes.label: partSearch
nodes.desc: Reads blocks from a single part (partSearch at L18) via the block cache.

nodes.label: Block
nodes.desc: Columnar block of TSIDs, timestamps and values: Block (L22), UnmarshalData (L250).

nodes.label: blockStreamReader
nodes.desc: Streaming reader over a part's block sequence (blockStreamReader at L17).

nodes.label: blockStreamWriter
nodes.desc: Streaming writer that serializes, compresses and persists blocks (blockStreamWriter at L16).

nodes.label: indexDB
nodes.desc: Per-partition inverted index: indexDB (L77), mustOpenIndexDB (L168), createGlobalIndexes (L415), SearchTSIDs (L1934).

nodes.label: TagFilters
nodes.desc: Query filters on label pairs (TagFilters at L160) compiled into index lookups.

nodes.label: MetricName
nodes.desc: MetricName (L137) holds the metric group plus tags; marshaled (L409) as the index key material.
